title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked TV Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content: NBC Universal revealed three new cast members for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga on Monday. The new characters will appear in the anime's ninth episode on Wednesday.

title: Sony Music Entertainment Japan, GungHo Online Entertainment Form Capital, Business Alliance
content: GungHo Online Entertainment announced on Friday that it is entering into a capital and business alliance with Sony Music Entertainment Japan (SME). SME will acquire shares of GungHo in an off-market bilateral transaction for the total offering price of 28,635,502,500 yen (about US$179,347,387).
author: ANN

title: Webtoon Ent. Reports US$15.6 Million Operating Loss in 2nd Quarter of 2026
content: WEBTOON Entertainment Inc. reported an operating loss of US$15.6 million for the second quarter of 2026, widening from an operating loss of US$8.8 million in the same period last year. The company disclosed the results on August 10. Quarterly revenue came in at US$338.5 million, down 2.8% year-over-year.
author: ANN
